issues.failure_explanation: Appendix A derives Xi_{t+1} = t/(t+1)(Xi_t + R_t Lambda_t R_t^T), where Lambda_t has upper-left block [[0,1],[1,a_t]] and Lambda_33 = 1/(t phi_t). Woodbury then needs Pi_t = Lambda_t^{-1}. The inverse of [[0,1],[1,a_t]] is [[-a_t,1],[1,0]]. The main text states Pi_t with +a_t in the (1,1) entry, so it is not Lambda_t^{-1}. The displayed recursion for Xi_{t+1}^{-1}, as stated in the main text, therefore does not follow from the appendix derivation and gives an incorrect inverse. The appendix formula in terms of Lambda_t^{-1} is itself correct.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace +a_t by -a_t in the (1,1) entry of Pi_t, so that Pi_t = Lambda_t^{-1}, matching the appendix.
issues.overall_effect: The claimed fully online update of the inverse estimator for confidence regions (Corollary sec4:cor1 ellipsoid) is wrong as written. The confidence-interval part and the consistency results are unaffected.
issues.title: Wrong sign in the matrix Pi_t of the online inverse-update formula for the confidence region
issues.why_classification: It is a one-entry local correction that follows directly from the appendix derivation. No theorem, rate or guarantee changes.
